data.description:
## Context
When document-creation stories are created (e.g., 'Update project docs', 'Add CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md entry'), there is currently no explicit signal for whether the change warrants an ADR (Architecture Decision Record). This leads to either: (a) ADRs silently skipped for decisions that deserve documentation, or (b) ADR bloat from decisions too minor to record.

## Goal
Establish clear criteria for when ADR creation should be triggered alongside a document-creation story. This should be resolved via brainstorm before implementation.

## Placeholder Notes
- Candidate trigger signals: new config key introduced, behavior change with observable side effects, agent routing change, new skill or phase added
- Anti-triggers (no ADR needed): cosmetic rewording, adding examples to existing docs, formatting fixes
- Should integrate into preplanning or sprint doc-story dispatch so the ADR trigger is automatic, not manual

## Success Criteria (to be refined in brainstorm)
- Criteria exist that determine when an ADR is required vs optional vs not needed for any document-creation story
- The criteria are enforced or at minimum surfaced as a checklist item during preplanning or sprint doc-story dispatch
- Document-creation stories that trigger ADR criteria produce a linked ADR ticket as a dependency
data.title: ADR creation discipline: when to create ADRs during document-creation stories
